I do not typically try to take one example of someone being openly in flagrantly wrong and draw a pattern from it - people get things wrong and this guy should correct himself. But in this case, it absolutely is a pattern and it demonstrates a tendency within the liberal ideology which is incentivise by the structure of our system: why exactly would they flex any of the power they have if they have a base of loyal supporters that will stay with them as long as they stay slightly to the left of republicans, but risk losing those moderates if they move at all to the left.
